page.notes: Blue and underlined marks in the scan are later annotations, not printed text, and are not transcribed. The right column is cut off at its foot, and the page continues beyond this part. Lower-left strip shows a line "Sed etiam creatori oppugnat anium. 270" partly cut off; the scan is faint in places, and the entries with blue underlined numbers are marked as printed. Some word endings are uncertain in the Hierosolymitani and Obscuritatis lines.
